name: MES Displayed Liquidity Shadow v1
instrument: one MES executed using recorded MBP-1 quotes
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 MES MBP-1 with ES session eligibility
hypothesis: Visible top-of-book size is not necessarily support or resistance. A larger displayed queue can be a liquidity target that attracts marketable flow. During the final half hour, price should move toward the side displaying more immediately consumable liquidity.

eligibility.entry_and_exit_quotes: finite, positive, non-crossed recorded MBP-1 bid and ask
eligibility.entry_sizes: finite nonnegative top-of-book bid and ask size
eligibility.spread_filter: none; cross the recorded spread regardless of width

signal.observation: first MES MBP-1 record at or after 15:30:05 ET
signal.long_signal: displayed ask size > displayed bid size
signal.short_signal: displayed bid size > displayed ask size
signal.interpretation: trade toward the larger visible liquidity target, opposite the conventional support/resistance reading

execution.stop: none; one MES and a fixed approximately 29-minute holding period bound exposure
execution.long_exit: recorded bid at the first MBP-1 record at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.short_exit: recorded ask at the first MBP-1 record at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: the full recorded MES bid-ask spread is crossed at entry and exit; no additional modeled slippage

lesson: Trading toward the larger displayed queue did not produce a stable aggregate edge. The positive short result and positive 2022 result are post-hoc asymmetries and cannot be selected. A single top-of-book snapshot appears too transient or directionally asymmetric to support this rule.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: reversing the queue direction after observing results
adding a size-ratio or spread threshold
combining the queue with price, return, or flow direction
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
